title: Tantric Prayer
claim: Nine rasas, four prayers each — thirty-six verses for the weather inside you. This is the book for emotional states: the classical table fixed by Abhinavagupta in the Abhinavabhāratī, where he added the ninth, shanta. The claim is old and radical: an emotion is not an obstacle to practice — it is consciousness already tasting itself in that key. So this book never argues with a feeling; it gives it its Sanskrit name, its literal sense and its verse, and the prayer re-tastes the emotion instead of banishing it. The companion Practical Prayers covers the clock; this one covers what the clock does to you.

sections_plan.purpose: the Comic — mirth, laughter, the lighter register
the Pathetic — grief, compassion, the tender wound
the Furious — anger and rage at full heat
the Heroic — valour, energy, the raised spine
the Horrible — fear and anxiety; holds the operative fear-chant (aghora), not only verses about fear

inclusion: a verse belongs in a rasa section only if that emotion is what the verse re-tastes — the feeling gives the section, never the other way
each rasa keeps exactly four entries; a practice-chant (like aghora in Bhayanaka) counts as one of the four
each entry carries source_path + source_ref to a file in this book's sources/ and four explainer blocks (what/how/sign, feel optional)

verses are from our own Kashmir Shaiva corpus in Swamiji's recitation orbit: 33+ from Utpaladeva's Shivastotravali plus Ghatakarpara, Kramastotra, Gitarthasangraha; translations ours, checked against corpus witnesses
content is extract-and-place from named sources and layers; clarity-edits only after placing; no source = block stays off the page (fail closed)
whole book must preflight under the template page ceiling with the template style before the build stage opens

every entry faces its explanation per EXPLAINER.md: brief (one sentence / IN ONE SENTENCE), what/logic (the turn), how/howto (When/Act/Return), sign (ordinary return only) — feel optional; no somatic promises; cut pocket lines labelled EXTRACT
exclusion: the Sangha section (Swamiji's chanted hymns) is out of the rasa book — practice-hymns are not rasa verses (owner ruling 2026-11-06); usable hymns move to Practical Prayers' Anytime or retire
no entry may also appear in Practical Prayers — one prayer, one book, never both
dhyana mantras are not rasa verses and too long for pocket use — the three Bahurupa dhyana mantras retire (owner ruling 2026-11-06)
Lakshmanjoo/Dyczkowski prose is never printed beyond brief attributed quotation in front matter; theory quotes stay short and attributed
no entry may appear in another book — one prayer, one book (cross-book id and IAST uniqueness is gate-enforced)
no agent-written prose anywhere in the entry fields; translations are ours, Lakshmanjoo/Dyczkowski prose is never printed beyond brief attributed quotation
no PDF build before content, structure, and formatting are confirmed — the build stage is the LAST stage of the pipeline, never the first
no somatic success tests or promised sensations in guide copy (EXPLAINER.md); modern adaptations labelled as adaptations, never as ancient prescription
